borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Disney+'s iOS app is a cinema lobby rendered in deep space-navy. The canvas is `#0A0E2A` — a rich midnight blue, not black — that evokes a darkened theater and the night sky over a castle. Surfaces step up to `#12152E` and `#1A1F3D`, with `#2A3050` hairline dividers. The mood is premium, magical, and aspirational: the app is a portal into five storytelling universes (Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic), and every screen is staged like a film billboard. The signature visual is the starfield — a subtle scatter of faint white points layered behind the hero billboard so the whole interface feels like it's floating in the same space as the streaming logo animation.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: Selected/focused: 2pt `#1A75FF` border + a `rgba(26,117,255,0.35)` outer glow + scale 1.04

borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4
borders.description: The accent system is a confident Disney Blue. `#0063E5` is the primary brand and CTA color; a brighter glow blue (`#1A75FF`) is used for focus halos, selected brand-portal tiles, and the play-button bloom. There is no second brand hue — the cinematic color comes from full-bleed content artwork, not UI chrome. White (`#FFFFFF`) is primary text; a cool periwinkle-gray (`#A0A6C0`) carries metadata and descriptions, tuned to harmonize with the navy. The restraint keeps the focus on the billboards and the brand portals — the content is the spectacle.

borders.label: 边框 5 - Border 5
borders.description: A subtle `rgba(26,117,255,0.30)` glow can sit behind it on the billboard

do: 建议：Use the deep space-navy canvas ({#0A0E2A}) with a faint starfield behind the hero。
建议：Reserve Disney Blue ({#0063E5}) for primary actions; use glow blue ({#1A75FF}) for focus halos and selected tiles。
建议：Make the brand-portal tile row (Disney/Pixar/Marvel/Star Wars/Nat Geo) a prominent, defining element。
建议：Use 16:9 landscape cards — the streaming/TV aspect, never square music tiles。
建议：Stage the hero as a full-bleed billboard with logo artwork and an auto-playing muted trailer。
dont: 避免：use pure black or a flat gray canvas — Disney+ is rich navy {#0A0E2A} with a starfield。
避免：add a second brand hue — content artwork supplies the color。
避免：use square (1:1) content tiles — Disney+ is 16:9 landscape。
避免：replace logo artwork with plain text titles when branded logos exist。
避免：drop the brand-portal row — it's the signature navigation。
